source_map_note: sleep_start, sleep_duration, activity_walking and steps_steps_total can come from the wearable or the phone. Assigned to the wearable as the primary source. Mobile is the fallback when the wearable has no record; that split is not applied day by day. The alternative rule (no heart rate and no SpO2, with steps or sleep present, implies the phone) is not used. Location and app use are mobile. practiced_sport is derived from activity, not counted in either source mean.
source_means: coverage_wearable averages the four primary-wearable variables. coverage_mobile averages location and app use. practiced_sport is excluded from both.
calendar_rule: Dense expected calendar of N days ending at decision_date; holes kept; not trimmed to last received record.
progressions: one progression per patient; n_progressions = patients with at least one positive 120-day horizon in the cell
zeros: Observed zeros count as data after the range clip; values below the clip floor are blank. practiced_sport has no clip of its own. It is counted only when activity_walking survived [120, 15000] s. A stored sport value on a day whose walking was removed by that filter is missing. A stored 0 with raw walking and running both empty is already missing. This rule is applied before bands, the variable table, centre and tumour means, continuous coverage, and the availability indicators.
variable_table_denominator: Same 90-day windows. Variable coverage_on_row divides by days that have a daily row (pct_days_with_row), not by all 90 calendar days. cov_practiced_sport counts only days whose walking survived the activity filter.
comparator_block: Not run here; coordinate with comparator pack (availability vs DCABP vs DCABP+availability).

coverage_by_source.day_observed: at least one of the source's variables observed after the range filters
coverage_by_source.gap: run of >= 2 consecutive calendar days with no observation from that source
coverage_by_source.denominator: the calendar days the alarm used: 90 or 30 days ending at the decision, or, in the 6 decisions whose data end earlier, from the start of the first block to the last day with data; every window lies inside the patient's digital monitoring period (first to last daily record), not the clinical follow-up; no separate activation or end date per device is available
coverage_by_source.breakdowns: coverage_breakdowns.csv: variable, source, centre and tumour with the same columns (90 d, full calendar denominator); unit coverage mean, median, IQR across decisions, and share of decisions with a gap of >= 2 days with nothing observed for that unit

coverage_interaction.model: logit P(y120) = b0 + b1 load_z + b2 cov_z + b3 load_z*cov_z, no penalty, z-scored on the 1013 decisions per window
coverage_interaction.uncertainty: patient bootstrap percentile (1000, seed 20261119+window) and cluster-robust sandwich SE by patient
coverage_interaction.discrimination: same as the frozen baseline: fixed scores (linear predictor) on the 1013 decisions, no cross-validation; patient bootstrap CI and paired difference vs the frozen load
coverage_interaction.replaces: the earlier fixed score load_z + load_z*cov_z (all weights 1, no coverage main effect, nothing fitted)
